defs.title: Release-review pipeline: the disclosure-control layer audits the invented fixture against the public ceiling and builds an in-memory sanitized packet, the evidence layer projects text-free audit and hashed-ledger JSON, and the visual layer renders the 4x4 proof matrix with optional steganography and Kmyth TPM sidecars.
defs.desc: Two-layer flow diagram. Layer one runs disclosure control: typed fixture load, classification ceiling and span validation, orphan and coverage checks, then an in-memory sanitized packet. Layer two projects a text-free audit and hashed release ledger, then renders the 4x4 visual proof matrix with steganography and optional Kmyth TPM sidecar sealing.
